<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/diy-smartphone-repair">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Repair">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Owner" name="Smartphone owner" processRef="Process_Repair"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Tool" name="Online repair tool"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Expert" name="Repair expert"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_RepairDetails" name="Phone model and damage" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Participant_Tool"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Lists" name="Materials, tools, and ordering choices" sourceRef="Participant_Tool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Instructions" name="Repair instructions" sourceRef="Participant_Tool" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_ToExpert" name="Smartphone sent for expert repair" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="Participant_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="Process_Repair" name="DIY Repair of a Broken Smartphone Screen" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Repair" name="Start DIY smartphone repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterDetails" name="Enter smartphone model and damage in the online tool"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveLists" name="Receive materials, tools, and ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAvailableItems" name="Identify listed items already available"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" name="Are any listed items still needed?"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about items?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ContactFriends" name="Contact friends about borrowing or buying items cheaply"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeContact" name="Continue obtaining needed items"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_BuyItems" name="Buy remaining materials and tools using the ordering choices"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeItems" name="Continue after sourcing items"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveInstructions" name="Receive repair instructions from the online tool"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RepairPhone" name="Repair smartphone using the instructions"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RepairWorked" name="Did the repair work?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendReview" name="Send a review of the repair"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SendVideo" name="Send a video of the repair"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_MergeReview" name="Continue after sending review or video"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendToExpert" name="Send smartphone to an expert"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_ReviewVideo" name="Review and/or video sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Expert" name="Smartphone sent to an expert"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="Start_Repair" targetRef="Task_EnterDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_EnterDetails" targetRef="Task_ReceiveLists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveLists" targetRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Task_CheckAvailableItems" targetRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" name="Items remain to obtain" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">itemsRemainToObtain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No items remain to obtain" sourceRef="Gateway_ItemsNeeded" targetRef="Gateway_MergeItems">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">noItemsRemainToObtain</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Task_ContactFriends">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">contactFriends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeContact">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">doNotContactFriends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="Task_ContactFriends" targetRef="Gateway_MergeContact"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeContact" targetRef="Task_BuyItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_BuyItems" targetRef="Gateway_MergeItems"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeItems" targetRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveInstructions" targetRef="Task_RepairPhone"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Task_RepairPhone" targetRef="Gateway_RepairWorked"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" name="Worked" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Task_SendReview">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairWorked</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" name="Did not work" sourceRef="Gateway_RepairWorked" targetRef="Task_SendToExpert">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">repairDidNotWork</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Gateway_MergeReview"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="Task_SendReview" targetRef="Task_SendVideo">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">alsoSendVideo</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_MergeReview" targetRef="End_ReviewVideo"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Task_SendToExpert" targetRef="End_Expert"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
